support_protocol.description: Canonical voltage clamp histories: alternating long hyperpolarization/recovery and brief repeated depolarizing bursts, randomized durations/amplitudes. No fresh evaluation traces are used to manufacture targets.

objective: All arms retain52d trajectory plus perchannel loss. G adds0.1*[mean family loss + maximum family loss]; each family loss combines asinh(log10 opening residual)^2, normalized current MSE, cumulative signed charge and peak-magnitude error. Identical fit-only scales for allarms. S replaces half the teacher windows only; coupled batches are identical.
selection: Common validation ordinary and targeted windows plus autonomous V/Ca. For each seed require no increase in any channel's validation current MSE, V MSE or Ca MSE versus initial52d, within1e-6 relative plus1e-12 numeric tolerance. Among eligible checkpoints choose lowest common full objective. Initial checkpoint is fallback; no eligible trained checkpoint is not success. These are additional selection guards, not changes to scientific acceptance thresholds.

cost.scope: Same three-seed atomic update andreadout; not whole neuron.

diagnostics: Fit-only decoder diagnostic before launch; shared128 vs512tick gradient probe; unchanged encoder and controls; initial fallback eligibility, per-channel nonregression; saved fresh coupled panel and current substitutions as52d.
limitations: Exploratory reused52coupled panel; new development clamp targets do not create independent confirmation. Numerical free-latent decoder witnesses are not temporal feasibility. Decoder remains trainable, encoder remains frozen; no state dimensions or online physical gates added. Nonregression on development cannot guarantee nonregression on evaluation.
